meta.note:
No generator script is committed. To regenerate: call RAGFlowHtmlParser.read_text_recursively on the sample at chunk_token_num=512, apply the TITLE_TAGS heading prefix ("# "/"## " …) inline, emit every block (including the inline …
markup) as a {"text": …, "doc_type_kwd": "text"} record, then wrap in {meta, items}. This mirrors gen_markdown_golden.py's separate_tables=false behaviour — parser-block granularity, NOT the flow's chunk_block(512) merging — so the golden exercises the table markup rather than dropping it. Go also appends a structured doc_type_kwd:"table" item; that extra record is excluded by FilterByDocType("text") in the alignment test.
